hypotheses.hypothesis: Untrusted external content never grants tool, publishing or secret access.
hypotheses.comparison: Existing PR340 FeedbackLearningLoop is draft; main has no verified active ingestion.
hypotheses.regression: Attempt prompt-injection and tool-action strings in external summaries; assert zero commands, zero publication.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Accessible original diagrams with stable asset identity improve search discoverability without fabricated traffic claims.
hypotheses.comparison: Search Console property-level multimodal performance data not accessed.
hypotheses.regression: Verify canonical metadata, alt text, robots indexing, actual Search Console reports only with authorized property and consent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Textual SVG labels and meaningful descriptions make graphics more usable.
hypotheses.comparison: SVG title/desc and color-independent numbering verified visually, screen-reader tests not run.
hypotheses.regression: Test at 320px/375px and with screen readers; check contrast and meaningful alternatives.
